verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents a large ecosystem of open-source plugins for many AI providers. Models can be reached through LiveKit Inference or connected directly to a wider range of providers, and the TTS interface explicitly accepts API key and base URL overrides for providers that aren't included. That establishes multi-provider TTS pluggability, but the evidence never names specific TTS providers or describes a browsable voice library. Missing for 10: a documented broad voice library or voice catalog, a named list of supported TTS providers, voice selection or customization docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of swapping TTS providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: LiveKit Agents includes a large ecosystem of open source plugins for a variety of AI providers.
you can use the open source plugins to connect directly to a wider range of model providers.
For any provider not included, you can override the API key and base URL at initialization for the LLM, STT, and TTS interfaces in the plugin.
